name: Borovicka Capital
decision_note: Prague family investment vehicle of Jakub Borovička, his father and brother, investing the family's own money (the father lends it) in Central European startups (e.g. Edmund AI pre-seed, Feb 2025) - a family office rather than a VC fund with managed capital.

evidence.quote: Borovicka Capital is an investment company with a strategic focus on venture capital investments in the Central European region.
We seek promising startups and foster their growth and development right from the early stages of their journey.
Táta dává ty peníze formou půjček, ty se mu tak časem vrátí.
Kdo investuje: Investiční kolo vedl český fond Lighthouse Ventures, ke kterému se přidaly také Czech Founders VC, deeptechový Tensor Ventures a Borovicka Capital.

analyst_notes: CzechCrunch interview (2025-02-20) calls it a 'rodinný fond': Jakub Borovička with his father and brother pooled family money ('složili jsme dohromady peníze') in 2023; the father provides the capital as loans; eight portfolio startups at the time (e.g. Wewell, Outfindo, Edmund AI). No external LPs, fund vehicle or regulated status was found, so it is typed family_office (alternative reading: private_investor) and excluded S1 although its own site describes venture capital investing in Central Europe. Active: Edmund AI (Ostrava) EUR 500k pre-seed led by Lighthouse Ventures (round amount from the next line of the same article); Outfindo round with Eleven Ventures (CzechCrunch 2025-01-20). Ticket EUR 500k-1.25m appears only in aggregator profiles (not used). Stage from the site's 'early stages' wording.
